R.Q.    Notices. All notices required and permitted under this Agreement shall be deemed
              to have been given, if and when deposited in the U.S. Mail, properly stamped and
              addressed to the party for whom intended at such party’s address listed herein, or
              when personally delivered personally to such party. A party may change its address
              for notice hereunder by giving written notice to the other party.

      R.      Compliance with Laws. Rotary shall comply with all applicable federal, state, or
              local laws, regulations, and ordinances.
